TaskHandler.RequestGlobalDispose.desc: Registers an object in the global dispose listener table (weak), so RemoveObject later calls its OnGlobalDispose.

params.obj: Listener object; it must implement OnGlobalDispose.

TaskHandler.RequestUpdate.desc: Queues an object for the next frame's Update, de-duplicated via obj.__inUpdateQueue.

TaskHandler.RemoveObject.desc: Notifies the global dispose listeners and removes the object from the Update queue (swap-with-last removal).
TaskHandler.RemoveObject.returns: true when removed, false/nil when it was not queued.

TaskHandler.RequestInstantUpdate.desc: Queues an object for InstantUpdate, which Update drains in a same-frame loop.

TaskHandler.Update.desc: Calls Update on the objects collected during the previous frame, then loops until the InstantUpdate queue is empty (each call via SafeCall).

module.summary: Update scheduler: collect objects requesting Update / InstantUpdate, dispatch them from TaskHandler.Update every frame, and broadcast disposal (OnGlobalDispose).

fileDesc: Update scheduling: collects objects requesting Update or InstantUpdate, invokes them in batch from TaskHandler.Update every frame, and broadcasts object destruction events.
